scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run check:artifacts && npm run check:performance
scripts.cf:build:production: tsc -b && node scripts/build-production.mjs && npm run check:artifacts && npm run check:performance
scripts.cf:migrate:production: node scripts/run-production-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy:production: npm run cf:build:production && node scripts/run-production-wrangler.mjs deploy --config dist/sweet_study_club/wrangler.json
scripts.cf:login:asal: node scripts/run-asal-wrangler.mjs login --browser=false --scopes account:read user:read workers:write workers_scripts:write d1:write
scripts.cf:build:asal: tsc -b && node scripts/build-asal.mjs && npm run check:artifacts
scripts.cf:deploy:asal: npm run cf:build:asal && node scripts/run-asal-wrangler.mjs deploy --config dist/sweet_study_club/wrangler.json
scripts.cf:migrate:asal: node scripts/run-asal-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env asal --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations list DB --local
